_why: Written because iteration 3 was marked 'all objective acceptance gates passed' while half the brief's sub-requirements were never built: the pillar probes were PROSE, so nothing could fail on them. This file is the requirement list as data, and tests/star_swarm_concept_test.php gates it. A requirement that is not in here is not enforced.

observability._why: Behaviour cannot be probed honestly by pixel-guessing alone; the game exposes a minimal read-only surface.

spec_probes._why: Each name (or an alternative separated by |) must appear inside an expect(...) statement in tests/browser/star-swarm.spec.ts. Existence is checked mechanically here; strictness is checked by the chair and by the pixel thresholds themselves.
spec_probes.pairwiseMinDistance: no two live enemies overlap (P1: it is a swarm)
spec_probes.centroidPath: the colony centroid does not travel a straight line (P1: motion is emergent, not scripted)
spec_probes.dispersal: killing enemies measurably displaces their neighbours (P1: it breaks apart when struck)
spec_probes.moodSamples|moods|mood: state.mood takes >=2 distinct values across >=2 waves (P2: it has a mind)
spec_probes.moodCadence|cadence: the oscillation cadence differs between waves (P2: behaviour changes, not just speed)
spec_probes.scaleBands: >=3 distinct enemy scales are live at once (P3: the void reads as depth)
spec_probes.nurseryOrigin: new-wave enemies originate near the nursery planet (P3: it lives in a place)
spec_probes.silhouetteClasses: >=4 enemy classes separable by ink coverage and aspect ratio (P4: shape carries meaning)
spec_probes.roleCoverage: threat/ally/reward/hazard resolve through theme tokens (P4: meaning never depends on hue)

invariants._why: No sprites and no new dependency is what makes this module themable and shippable on shared hosting.
